name: Middle of Gelkak's Key
summary: Off Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast’s key lies in three pieces after threshadons sank his ship. Greymist murlocs took the middle fragment from the shore.

sections.title: A Fragment in the Silt
sections.body: Gelkak Gyromast’s winding key broke when threshadons dragged his ship beneath the waves. The gnome pirate came ashore with his belongings shattered on the rocky shoals. The specialized key was made for his mechanical first mate, but the wreck split it into three pieces scattered along the strand. Coastal beasts carried off the top and bottom. Greymist murlocs prowling the Darkshore surf took the middle piece and kept it in their camps and among the wreckage they hold.

faq.q: What is the Middle of Gelkak's Key used for?
aliases: why do i need this key
faq.answer: The Middle of Gelkak's Key is one of three pieces Gelkak Gyromast needs. Joined to the top and bottom, it makes the key that reactivates his mechanical first mate.

faq.q: Where did this key piece end up?
aliases: where to find middle of gelkak key
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs scavenged the middle fragment. It can be taken from raiders, oracles, netters, tidehunters, and other tribe members along Darkshore’s beaches and shipwrecks.

faq.q: Why was the key broken in the first place?
faq.answer: Aggressive threshadons sank Gelkak’s ship just offshore. The key broke into three pieces against the coastal rocks as the gnome washed ashore, and local scavengers carried the pieces away.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how this custom mechanical component winds and operates a clockwork first mate, a display of gnomish ingenuity in pirate hands.
